query:
WITH inserted_domain AS (
          INSERT INTO domains(domain, owner_id)
          VALUES ($1, $2)
          RETURNING *
        )
        SELECT
          d.id,
          d.domain,
          d.created_at,
          d.updated_at,
          (
            u.id,
            u.username,
            u.password_hash,
            u.created_at,
            u.updated_at
          ) AS "owner!: User"
        FROM inserted_domain d
        INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = d.owner_id;
